newsitem.title: USA: New Rochelle, N.Y. to get $148 mln for renewal - Gov.
newsitem.headline: New Rochelle, N.Y. to get $148 mln for renewal - Gov.

text.p: New York Gov. George Pataki on Thursday announced a $148 million plan to renew downtown New Rochelle, with a range of projects including an ice center, shops and housing.

The projects, expected to serve as a model for revitalizing New York cities that have seen jobs move out-of-state, should create more than 600 permanent jobs and 1,500 construction jobs when building starts early next year.

New Rochelle Center is expected to produce nearly as much in sales as its costs, as the state predicted it would generate up to $122.5 million in sales each year, plus more than $2 million in gross parking revenues. This will provide the City of New Rochelle with a net of more than $2 million.

"Many of the state's small cities, like New Rochelle, have seen their downtowns erode over the past two decades," Pataki said, in prepared remarks. "This much-needed injection of energy, excitement and commerce will ensure that New Rochelle shares in New York's ongoing economic renewal."
